unit_cn: Unit 1 Cultural Heritage 文化遗产
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 1 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、文化遗产/阿斯旺大坝/长城/敦煌主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.meaning_cn: 遗产(尤指国家或社会长期形成的历史、传统和特色)
words.example_en: We must protect our cultural heritage for future generations.
words.example_cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护我们的文化遗产。

words.example_en: The dam would have destroyed many ancient cultural relics.
words.example_cn: 这座大坝本会毁掉许多古老的文物遗迹。

words.example_en: Workers tried hard to preserve the temple from the rising water.
words.example_cn: 工人们努力保护这座庙宇免遭上涨的水淹没。

words.example_en: The government planned to build a dam across the Nile.
words.example_cn: 政府计划在尼罗河上修建一座大坝。

words.example_en: Engineers moved the ancient temple piece by piece to a safe place.
words.example_cn: 工程师们把这座古庙一块一块地搬到了安全的地方。

words.example_en: The reporter quoted a famous saying about cultural heritage.
words.example_cn: 记者引用了一句关于文化遗产的名言。

words.example_en: A committee was established to limit damage to the buildings.
words.example_cn: 成立了一个委员会以减少对这些建筑的损害。

words.example_en: They decided to establish a fund to save the temples.
words.example_cn: 他们决定设立一笔基金来拯救这些庙宇。

words.example_en: The group raised funds within the international community.
words.example_cn: 该团体在国际社会中筹集了资金。

words.example_en: Fifty countries contributed money to the Aswan Dam project.
words.example_cn: 五十个国家为阿斯旺大坝项目捐了款。

words.example_en: Every country made a contribution to rescue the cultural sites.
words.example_cn: 每个国家都为拯救这些文化遗址作出了贡献。

words.example_en: Many nations donated millions of dollars to the project.
words.example_cn: 许多国家为该项目捐赠了数百万美元。

words.example_en: Experts were asked to investigate the issue carefully.
words.example_cn: 专家受邀仔细调查这个问题。

words.meaning_cn: 组织;安排;进行;管理;行为;举止
words.example_en: The team conducted several tests before making a proposal.
words.example_cn: 团队在提出方案之前进行了几次测试。

words.example_en: They made a proposal for how the buildings could be saved.
words.example_cn: 他们就如何拯救这些建筑提出了一个方案。

words.meaning_cn: 文件;公文;文档;记录;记载
words.example_en: Finally, a document was signed and the work began.
words.example_cn: 最后,一份文件被签署,工程随之开始。

words.example_en: The committee tried to limit the damage to the temples.
words.example_cn: 委员会努力把对庙宇的损害降到最低。

words.example_en: The plan aimed to prevent the loss of cultural relics.
words.example_cn: 这个方案旨在防止文物的损失。

words.example_en: Saving the temples prevented a great loss for human history.
words.example_cn: 拯救这些庙宇避免了人类历史上的巨大损失。

words.meaning_cn: 过程;进程;步骤;处理;加工
words.example_en: A guide explained the process of building the pyramid.
words.example_cn: 一位向导解释了建造金字塔的过程。

words.example_en: We must keep a balance between progress and protection.
words.example_cn: 我们必须在发展与保护之间保持平衡。

words.example_en: The project hopes to promote interest in China's history.
words.example_cn: 这个项目希望促进人们对中国历史的兴趣。

words.meaning_cn: 传统;惯例;传统信仰或风俗
words.example_en: Cultural heritage includes a country's customs and traditions.
words.example_cn: 文化遗产包括一个国家的习俗和传统。

words.example_en: Scientists worked hard to identify each ancient relic.
words.example_cn: 科学家们努力辨认每一件古代文物。

words.meaning_cn: 数码的;数字显示的;数字技术的
words.example_en: Researchers collected digital images of the cave paintings.
words.example_cn: 研究人员收集了这些洞窟壁画的数字图像。

words.example_en: Nearly 500,000 high-quality images have been produced.
words.example_cn: 已经制作了将近五十万张高质量图像。

words.example_en: Tourists from all over the world visit the famous caves.
words.example_cn: 来自世界各地的游客都来参观这些著名的洞窟。

words.meaning_cn: 历史上著名(或重要)的;有史时期的
words.example_en: We should safeguard historic relics for future generations.
words.example_cn: 我们应当为子孙后代守护历史文物。

words.meaning_cn: 质量;品质;素质;特征;优质的
words.example_en: The team takes high-quality photos of the cultural relics.
words.example_cn: 团队为这些文物拍摄高质量的照片。

words.example_en: The government's first attempt to build the dam led to protests.
words.example_cn: 政府修建大坝的最初尝试引发了抗议。

words.example_en: Many citizens protested against destroying the temples.
words.example_cn: 许多市民抗议毁掉这些庙宇。

words.meaning_cn: 重要议题;争论的问题;宣布;公布
words.example_en: Protecting cultural heritage is an important issue today.
words.example_cn: 保护文化遗产是当今一个重要的议题。

words.example_en: In my opinion, saving the temples was truly worthwhile.
words.example_cn: 在我看来,拯救这些庙宇确实是值得的。

words.meaning_cn: 值得做的;值得花时间的
words.example_en: Spending so much money on the temples was worthwhile.
words.example_cn: 在这些庙宇上花这么多钱是值得的。

words.example_en: The group asked for contributions from different departments.
words.example_cn: 该团体向不同部门请求捐助。

words.meaning_cn: 专业的;职业的;专业人员
words.example_en: We met a professional guide at the entrance to the pyramid.
words.example_cn: 我们在金字塔入口处遇到了一位专业向导。

words.example_en: A crowd of tourists waited at the entrance to the temple.
words.example_cn: 一群游客在庙宇的入口处等候。

words.example_en: An exit is the door through which you can leave a building.
words.example_cn: 出口就是你可以离开一座建筑的那扇门。

words.example_en: The guide said the ancient mirror could tell right from wrong.
words.example_cn: 向导说这面古镜能分辨是非。

words.example_en: She looked at a strange carving on the temple roof.
words.example_cn: 她看着庙顶上一个奇特的雕刻。

words.example_en: By studying photos of the former palace, they rebuilt it exactly.
words.example_cn: 通过研究旧宫殿的照片,他们将它原样重建。

words.example_en: Water from the dam would likely damage the temples.
words.example_cn: 大坝的水很可能损坏这些庙宇。

words.example_en: Some Chinese cultural relics are now kept overseas.
words.example_cn: 一些中国文物如今被保存在海外。

words.example_en: The caves were a key stop throughout China's ancient history.
words.example_cn: 这些洞窟在中国古代历史中始终是一个重要驿站。

words.meaning_cn: 在(某段时间、距离或范围)之内
words.example_en: The committee raised funds within the international community.
words.example_cn: 委员会在国际社会内部筹集了资金。

words.meaning_cn: 创造性的;有创造力的;有创意的
words.example_en: Students found creative ways to protect their heritage.
words.example_cn: 学生们找到了保护遗产的创造性方法。

words.example_en: UNESCO prevents heritage sites from disappearing forever.
words.example_cn: 联合国教科文组织防止遗产地永远消失。

words.example_en: Neither people nor buildings last forever, but photos help us remember them.
words.example_cn: 人和建筑都不会永存,但照片能帮我们记住它们。
